videos.title: The new Mac mini with M6
videos.description:
Introducing the far mightier, new Mac mini, with the M6 chip. With up to 40% faster CPU and 2x faster graphics, it's five by five inches of pure power and performance. Add in neural accelerators in each core, for up to 4x faster AI performance and 2x faster storage, and it can handle whatever you throw at it, boosting your productivity to new heights.

Pre-order now. Available starting 9/22.

Learn more about Mac mini: https://apple.co/4ijabym

"Pili Pili" by Polo & Pan: https://music.apple/pili

videos.title: AirPods Max 2: The ultimate over-ear listening experience
videos.description:
AirPods Max 2 delivers high-fidelity audio powered by the H2 chip, with up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation. It offers personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, Live Translation, up to 20 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation, Lossless Audio via USB-C, and is available in five vibrant colors.

#AirPodsMax2 #ActiveNoiseCancellation #LiveTranslation

videos.title: Apple Watch Series 11: The ultimate way to watch your health
videos.description:
Apple Watch Series 11 can spot signs of chronic high blood pressure and notify you of possible hypertension. Sleep score helps you track and understand the quality of your sleep and Workout Buddy delivers personalized motivation in real time. Plus, a wide-angle Always-On Retina display, 5G cellular, and up to 24 hours of battery life.

#AppleWatchSeries11

videos.title: iPhone 17 Pro: The most powerful iPhone ever
videos.description:
iPhone 17 Pro features an innovative aluminum unibody design for the ultimate pro performance and battery life. Thanks to the power-efficient A19 Pro chip, iPhone 17 Pro delivers the best battery life of any iPhone, with up to 39 hours of video playback for iPhone 17 Pro Max. The 48MP Pro Fusion camera system has the longest iPhone telephoto ever, with 8x optical-quality zoom, as well as Camera Control, and sharp image capture in low light.

videos.title: iPhone 17: Built to last, and comes in five gorgeous colors
videos.description:
Meet the iPhone 17, with contoured edges, thinner borders, and durable Ceramic Shield 2 front that looks — and stays — beautiful. Its 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR display features ProMotion up to 120Hz for smoother scrolling. The efficient A19 chip powers Apple Intelligence for everyday tasks, and delivers long-lasting battery life, with up to 30 hours of video playback.
